newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro traders still await news on Iraq wheat tender.
newsitem.headline: Euro traders still await news on Iraq wheat tender.

text.p: European grain traders said on Wednesday they still had no news on the fate of an Iraqi tender for the import of 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat.
Iraq launched the tender on March 21 under the U.N.-monitored oil-for-food deal.
"We don't know what is happening. Prices may block negotiations," one trader said, adding talks were shrouded in secrecy.
The lowest offers initially received by Iraq stood at around $199-208 per tonne, cost and freight, for delivery to Jordan's port of Aqaba. The wheat is for May 15-June 15 shipment.
